translations.Godło Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej: Coat of arms of the Republic of Poland
translations.Kancelaria Notarialna, Monika Maj Notari: Monika Maj Notary Office in Banino
translations.Informacje dotyczące dokonywanych czynno: Information about notarial services, required documents and related fees is available at the office, by telephone or by email.
translations.Godziny Urzędowania: poniedziałek-piątek: Office hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 am–4:00 pm. Other appointments, including Saturdays, are available by prior arrangement.
translations.Kancelaria znajduje się przy ul. Borowie: The office is located at 3/2 Borowiecka Street, 80-297 Banino.
translations.Lokal jest dostępny dla osób z niepełnos: The office is accessible to people with disabilities, and parking is available on site.
translations.Możliwe jest umówienie wizyty w weekend: Weekend appointments can be arranged in advance by phone.
translations.Budynek kancelarii notarialnej przy ulic: Notary office building on Borowiecka Street in Banino
translations.Budynek kancelarii przy ul. Borowieckiej: The office building at 3/2 Borowiecka Street in Banino.
translations.Informacje o czynnościach wykonywanych w: Information about services provided by the office
translations.Właściwa forma, dokumenty i opłaty zależ: The appropriate form, documents and fees depend on the specific service and the parties’ circumstances. We will help you determine which documents are required and which are additionally recommended, helping ensure that the notarial process runs smoothly and that the matter is legally and formally secure.
translations.w przypadku, kiedy wymagają tego przepis: where required by law or requested by the parties
translations.czynności notarialne w zakresie obrotu n: Notarial services for primary and secondary real estate transactions involving land, residential and commercial premises, and cooperative ownership rights to premises for residential, commercial and investment purposes.
translations.W tym: umowy przedwstępne, umowy sprzeda: Including preliminary agreements, sale and gift agreements, life-annuity agreements, and agreements dissolving co-ownership.
translations.Poświadczenia własnoręczności podpisu, z: Certification of signatures, copies against documents presented, the date a document was presented and that a person is alive, within the scope permitted by law.
translations.Wnioski o wpis do księgi wieczystej zwią: Applications for entries in the land and mortgage register related to a notarial service, where provided for by law.
translations.testamenty, akty poświadczenia dziedzicz: Wills, certificates of inheritance, declarations accepting or rejecting an inheritance, and inheritance division agreements.
translations.umowy majątkowe małżeńskie, umowy o podz: Marital property agreements and agreements dividing joint property, both during marriage and after it ends.
translations.umowy spółki, oświadczenia o objęciu udz: Company agreements, declarations subscribing for shares in share capital or joining a company, minutes of shareholders’ meetings and general meetings of shareholders, and matters relating to succession management.
translations.Taksa notarialna, podatki i opłaty sądow: Notarial fees, taxes and court fees
translations.Wynagrodzenie notariusza za dokonane czy: The notary’s fee is agreed with the parties, taking into account the type and scope of the service, and may not exceed the maximum rates set by applicable law. Value added tax is added to the fee.
translations.W przypadkach przewidzianych przepisami: Where required by law, the notary also collects applicable taxes and court fees and transfers them to the relevant authorities.
translations.Zachęcamy, aby przed czynnością poprosić: Please contact the office for an individual cost estimate before your appointment.
translations.W przypadkach przewidzianych przepisami: Where required by law, the notary collects the tax on civil law transactions (PCC) or inheritance and gift tax and transfers it to the relevant tax office. Value added tax (VAT) at the applicable rate is added to the notary’s fee.
translations.W przypadku czynności notarialnych obejm: For notarial services involving an application to a court, a court fee is also collected in the amount prescribed by applicable law.
translations.Ze względu na różne stawki maksymalne i: Because maximum rates and statutory exceptions vary, we do not provide a single fee for an entire category of services. Please request an individual estimate before your appointment.
translations.Czy można umówić wizytę w weekend?: Can I make a weekend appointment?
translations.Tak. Istnieje możliwość umówienia czynno: Yes. Notarial appointments are also available on Saturdays by prior arrangement by phone at 574 637 761.
translations.Czy można płacić kartą lub przelewem?: Can I pay by card or bank transfer?
translations.Tak, kancelaria akceptuje płatność kartą: Yes, the office accepts card and bank transfer payments. Please confirm the payment method and timing before your appointment.
translations.Czy kancelaria jest dostępna dla osób z: Is the office accessible to people with disabilities?
translations.Tak. Lokal jest dostępny dla osób z niep: Yes. The office is accessible to people with disabilities, and parking is also available on site.
translations.Czy notariusz może przyjechać do klienta: Can the notary visit a client?
translations.Czynność poza kancelarią może zostać dok: A notarial service may be performed outside the office if its nature or special circumstances warrant it, in accordance with Article 3(2) of the Law on Notaries. The possibility and location must be agreed in advance.
translations.mObywatel. Czy mogę legitymować się elek: mObywatel: Can I identify myself using the electronic ID (mDowód)?
translations.W naszej kancelarii notarialnej korzysta: Our notary office can verify an mDowód free of charge through the relevant website.
translations.Gdzie uzyskam informację o taksie i pozo: Where can I find out about the notarial fee and other charges?
translations.Maksymalne stawki taksy notarialnej okre: Applicable law sets the maximum notarial fees. The fee depends on the type and scope of the planned service and, where relevant, the value of its subject matter. We assess each matter individually and prepare a detailed estimate covering the notarial fee, applicable taxes and court fees. You can confirm the costs with the office before your appointment.
translations.Zakres wymaganych dokumentów uzależniony: The required documents depend on the planned notarial service and the circumstances of the matter. After consulting the office by phone, email or in person, you will receive detailed information about the documents needed for the service.
translations.Czy po czynności otrzymam oryginał aktu: Will I receive the original notarial deed?
translations.Oryginał aktu pozostaje w kancelarii i j: The original deed remains at the office and is kept as required by law. The parties receive certified copies with the same legal effect as the original.
translations.Gdzie znajduje się kancelaria?: Where is the notary office located?
translations.Kancelaria znajduje się przy ul. Borowie: The office is located at 3/2 Borowiecka Street, 80-297 Banino. It serves clients in Banino and nearby areas, including Gdańsk (Bysewo, Kokoszki, Matarnia, Jasień, Niestępowo, Oliwa and Osowa), Gdynia (Dąbrowa, Karwiny, Wielki Kack, Chwarzno and Wiczlino), Sopot, Żukowo, Chwaszczyno, Pępowo, Rębiechowo, Tuchom, Tuchomek, Barniewice, Borowiec, Miszewo, Miszewko, Nowy Świat, Czaple, Nowy Tuchom, Otomino, Małkowo, Kowale, Glincz, Borkowo, Widlino, Czarne Błoto, Dębniak, Krowie Łąki, Leźno, Lisewo, Lisie Błoto, Lniska, Łapino Kartuskie, Mankocin, Piaski, Przyjaźń, Pustki Żukowskie, Rewerenda, Rutki, Skrzeszewo, Stara Piła and Sulmin.
translations.Notariat to dla mnie nie tylko zawód, al: For me, notarial work is not only a profession, but also a passion and a responsibility grounded in trust.
translations.Za każdą czynnością notarialną kryje się: Every notarial service involves many hours of work that may not be immediately visible. This includes analysing documents, checking legal status, clarifying questions and ensuring that your decisions are informed and their legal effects properly safeguarded. A secure transaction compliant with the law is the result of careful preparation, knowledge and experience.
translations.Pracę notariusza traktuję jako swoją pas: I am passionate about my work as a notary, but I believe a good professional partner should also be open-minded and well-rounded. That is why maintaining a balance between work and personal life and pursuing interests outside work are equally important to me. They help me maintain a fresh perspective, openness and commitment, which also shape the quality of my relationships with clients.
translations.Notariat jest zawodem zaufania publiczne: Notarial work is a public-trust profession with a distinct character. It requires not only legal knowledge and precision, but also independence, impartiality and the highest ethical standards. Responsibility, integrity and respect for the rules of the profession are the foundation of the trust on which my work is based.
translations.Istnieje możliwość ustalenia indywidualn: Individual appointment times, including Saturdays, can be arranged in advance with the office.
translations.Zadzwoń lub napisz. Opisz sprawę - ustal: Call or email us. Tell us about your matter and we will discuss the service and a convenient appointment time.
translations.Lokal dostępny dla osób z niepełnosprawn: The office is accessible to people with disabilities, and parking is available.
